thought.text: The `local-dev` profile uses `BUILD_OR_PULL_IMAGES=build`, which compiles backend and frontend locally. Since this can exceed the 600s command timeout, I'll run `start.sh` in the background and poll the log.

reasoning_content:
The local-dev profile uses BUILD_OR_PULL_IMAGES=build, meaning it will build the backend and frontend images locally, which can take a long time (npm ci, next build). The guide says local-dev builds images locally. Given resource constraints and time, maybe I should consider `--dev` which also builds. Actually the guide's default first-run local-dev has BUILD_OR_PULL_IMAGES=build. 

Hmm. But the pull method is documented for production profile. The guide says the primary local setup uses ./start.sh with local-dev. Let me try that. But building frontend Next.js can be slow. Let's just run start.sh and monitor. Note start.sh pulls ipfs/cluster/webui images and builds backend/frontend.

Let me first pre-pull in background? Actually let's just run ./start.sh with a long timeout. But the terminal has 600s fixed timeout. Building may exceed that. Better approach: run build in background with nohup, then poll.

Actually start.sh will also block on `until curl IPFS API`. Let me run it in background and log.

Let me run: nohup ./start.sh > /tmp/start.log 2>&1 & then poll.

But start.sh may prompt? No, .env exists so no prompt. Good.

Let me kick it off.
